messages:
nina: Quick sync idea - make fallback decisions explainable in one glance for oncall, but still forensically complete in audit. Need to balance noise and privacy.

raj: Agreed. Proposal: console card shows 3 things: 1) human-friendly reason (one line), 2) evidence snapshot (metric badges), 3) CTA -> full audit. No request text on the card.

oliver: Evidence snapshot = tiny list: p95_ms, error_pct, sample_rate. Keep it visually shallow so ops can triage fast.

sophie: For audit store we will keep hashed_prefix (sha256), token_count, redaction_flag, sampled_snippet_allowed boolean. Legal approved that.

nina: Nice. What about a confidence score? e.g., fallback_confidence: 0-100 to show how sure the decisioning engine was that fallback was correct. Could help triage false positives.

raj: I like confidence. Keep it in telemetry only (not user-visible by default). Maybe expose it as a tiny tooltip: "model confidence" for curious SREs.

oliver: API shape: GET /v1/fallbacks/decision?id=<id>. Response must be flat k/v. Example fields: decision_id, ts, reason, severity, p95_ms, err_pct, sample_pct, policy, rule_id, route_id, org_hash, override_state, confidence_pct. No nested arrays.

sophie: Decision id format should include org prefix: "<orghash>-aid-<shortid>" so cross-tenant tooling can't accidentally leak data.

nina: UX: card microcopy: "Routed to Quiet Degrade (latency spike p95 1.2s). View audit." Keep neutral tone. Add small est. cost delta line e.g., "est. cost +9%".

ops-bot: alert: fallback_rate("ingest-prod") = 2.4% over 10m -> paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:

raj: Sampling policy defaults: baseline 1% global, adaptive up to 25% during anomalous windows, and forced full sample for any operator override/permanent change.

oliver: On operator overrides: two kinds - transient (TTL, editable at application time) and permanent (requires ticket id & approver). Show who applied override on the card and the TTL countdown for transient ones.

sophie: Retention: default full audit retention 90d, sampled traces 30d, enterprise tiers configurable. Export option for CSV for PM/postmortem.

nina: Console filters: add quick toggle "only escalations" = severity >= warn && operator_override == false. Also a "sensitive" filter to hide lines where sampled_snippet_allowed = true unless you have data-access role.

raj: Telemetry tag names: fallback.policy, fallback.trigger, fallback.severity, fallback.confidence, fallback.p95_ms, fallback.err_pct, fallback.sample_pct, fallback.org_hash, fallback.override_by. Dot-separated for metrics store friendliness.

oliver: For audit indexing we need flat keys only; no nested objects. That will make queries faster and reduce complexity for retention jobs.

sophie: PII decision: store hashed_prefix + token_count + first_token_class (e.g., id/email/other) as an enum when detectable. That gives investigative context without exposing raw content.

nina: Operator inbox idea: surface top 5 recent critical fallbacks with quick actions: view, soft-override, create-ticket. Soft-override default TTL = 10m (configurable).

ops-bot: info: fallback_sampled(ingest-prod) count=8 in last 5m.

raj: One more UX affordance: show related decisions (by hashed_prefix) in side panel so operators can see if this is a repeat pattern. Use fuzzy time window by default +/- 15m.

oliver: Implementational note: keep side-panel read-only; any action that mutates state (override/permanent change) must go through an audited API and require an approver for permanent.

sophie: I'll add telemetry schema and retention windows to infra-telemetry repo. nina, can you mock the card and side panel microcopy?

nina: Yup, will prototype in figma and include microcopy strings. Drafting a short RFC to pin defaults (ttl=10m, retention=90d, baseline sampling=1%).

raj: If no strong objections, I'll draft the API spec and a lightweight migration plan for existing decisions so ids change to org-prefixed format.

nina: Sounds good. Let's keep the console minimal and the audit comprehensive. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
